comment: dig.c dig():391-402, the downward-digging branch for a hero held in a bear trap: when rnl(7) exceeds 4 she hits herself in the foot, and worn boots (uarmf) halve the damage. A human Valkyrie in debug mode raises herself to level 10 (ESC dismisses the level-up messages) so the trap and the pick-axe cannot kill her, wishes for low boots (e) and wears them, wishes for a pick-axe (f), steps north, wishes for a bear trap there, steps off and back on so that it closes on her foot, and applies the pick-axe downward. Seed 8830124 is the first of seeds 8830122-8830130 whose rnl(7) roll took the hit branch (also 8830125 and 8830126). Date and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
